title: Northstar generation receipt v1
description: Durable live machine tombstone for one closed generation, written at .northstar/lifecycle/v1/generations/gNN.json by compaction. It carries the canonical terminal task summaries, the source task-set digest the closure record pinned, and the closure digest as provenance; the detailed per-task records are removed and remain only in Git history. It is valid only beside the exact closure record it names, so a stale closure, malformed receipt, or uncovered fragment fails closed before any deletion.

source_digest.description: Digest of the sorted terminal task summaries the closure record pinned. Recomputed from the full fragment set at first compaction and never from a partial set.

closure_digest.description: Digest of the exact closure record that authorized this receipt, so reopening or rewriting closure authority invalidates it.

tasks.description: Exact terminal task entries, sorted by task id. Every remaining fragment must match one entry exactly before it may be deleted.
